first_line: Comfort, comfort ye my people
Prepare the way, O Zion
Lift up your heads, ye mighty gates
note: the index cuts it short: "Lift up your heads"

first_line: O Bride of Christ, rejoice
Thou Jesus Christ didst man become
Hark, the glad sound, the Savior comes
Arise, the kingdom is at hand
Hail to the Lord's Anointed
Oh! how shall I receive Thee
note: the index prints "recieve"

first_line: Come, Thou Savior of our race
Come, Thou long-expected Jesus
Rejoice, all ye believers
note: the index prints "beleivers"

first_line: All hail to thee, O blessed morn
Behold the joyful day is nigh
Rejoice, rejoice, ye Christians
Good news from heaven the angels bring
note: the index cuts it short: "Good news from heaven"

first_line: Immanuel, we sing Thy praise
The happy Christmas comes once more
Joy to the world! the Lord is come
note: the index cuts it short: "Joy to the world"

first_line: Come hither, ye faithful, triumphantly sing
note: the index cuts it short: "Come hither, ye faithful"

first_line: A great and mighty wonder
Hark! what mean those holy voices
Angels, from the realms of glory
Hark! the herald angels sing
Hark, a burst of heavenly music
All my heart this night rejoices
When Christmas morn is dawning
O little town of Bethlehem
Silent night! holy night
I love to hear the story
Now we bring our Christmas treasures
Hark! what sounds are sweetly stealing
Lo! Jesus' Name rich comfort is
How sweet the Name of Jesus sounds
Jesus, Name all names above
Jesus, Name of wondrous love
Take the Name of Jesus with you
There is no name so sweet on earth
The old year now hath passed away
Help us, O Lord, behold we enter
Great God, we sing that mighty Hand
For Thy mercy and Thy grace
While with ceaseless course the sun
Our times are in Thy hand
A star is moving through the sky
As with gladness men of old
Now Israel's hope in triumph ends
Brightest and best of the sons of the morning
O Thou, who by a star didst guide
Hail, Thou Source of every blessing
Light of the Gentile nations
O Christ our true and only light
Rise, O Salem, rise and shine
Christ the Life of all the living
Lord, Thy death and passion give
Suffering Son of Man, be near me
Jesus, Refuge of the weary
Savior, when in dust to Thee
There is a fountain filled with blood
All praise to Thee, our Savior good
I gave My life for thee
Ride on, ride on in majesty
Passion-week memories
Go to dark Gethsemane
'Tis midnight, and on Olive's brow
Over Kidron Jesus treadeth
Good Friday, Good Friday
In the cross of Christ I glory
Sweet the moments rich in blessing
When I survey the wondrous cross
'Tis finished, so the Savior cried
Thy cross, O Jesus, Thou didst bear
O Sacred Head now wounded
O Lamb of God, most holy
A Lamb goes uncomplaining forth
What comfort sweet to pause
My crucified Savior, despised and contemned
note: the index cuts it short: "My crucified Savior"

first_line: Stricken, smitten, and afflicted
Alas! and did my Savior bleed
Blest Easter day, what joy is thine
Christ is risen from the dead
Christ the Lord is risen to-day, Sons of men
note: Charles Wesley's; the index adds "Sons of men" to tell it from 84, which opens alike

first_line: He liveth forever
Christ the Lord is risen to-day
note: Jane E. Leeson's, which the hymn marks "From the Latin" (Victimae paschali laudes); not Wesley's, 82, which opens alike

first_line: The day of Resurrection
Day of wonder, day of gladness
Morning breaks upon the tomb
Come, see the place where Jesus lay
Welcome, Thou Victor in the strife
Praise the Savior now and ever
note: the index cuts it short: "Praise the Savior"

first_line: In death's strong grasp the Savior lay
note: the index cuts it short: "In death's strong grasp"

first_line: I know that my Redeemer lives
Blow ye the trumpet, blow
To realms of glory I behold
O Jesus, who art gone before
See the Conqueror mounts in triumph
Hail the day that sees Him rise
Hail, Thou once despised Jesus
The Head that once was crowned with thorns
Hark, ten thousand harps and voices
All hail the power of Jesus' Name
Come, Holy Spirit, God and Lord
Holy Ghost, dispel our sadness
Come, oh, come Thou quickening Spirit
Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove
O Holy Spirit, enter in
Gracious Spirit, Dove divine
Holy Ghost, with light divine
Lord God, the Holy Ghost
Come, Holy Spirit, from above
In all danger be our stay
We all believe in one true God
Almighty God, eternal Lord
Come, Thou almighty King
Glory to the Father give
Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God Almighty
Hail! holy, holy, holy Lord
Our Father merciful and good
The God who reigns on high
Before Jehovah's awful throne
All glory be to God on high
With joyful heart your praises bring
Sing praise to God who reigns above
note: the index cuts it short: "Sing praise to God"

first_line: Oh, bless the Lord, my soul
My soul, repeat His praise
Come, sound His praise abroad
Praise the Lord, ye heavens, adore Him
Lord, with glowing heart I'd praise Thee
Oh, what praises shall we render
God is love: His mercy brightens
Love divine, all love excelling
Praise the Lord each tribe and nation
Now thank we all our God
We gather, we gather, dear Jesus, to bring
Come let us sing of Jesus
See the shining dewdrops
Children of the heavenly King
Jesus high in glory
Humble praises, holy Jesus
Savior, who Thy flock art feeding
When little Samuel woke
O Thou, whose infant feet were found
Savior, like a shepherd lead us
What a friend we have in Jesus
Come, my soul, Thy suit prepare
Sweet hour of prayer
O Fount of truth and mercy
Lord, teach us how to pray aright
Come, Savior dear, with us abide
O Jesus Christ, Thy grace us lend
Blessed Jesus, at Thy word
Open now thy gates of beauty
In Thy Name, O Lord, assembling
Oh, enter, Lord, Thy temple
Come, Thou Fount of every blessing
Safely through another week
O day of rest and gladness
Guardian of pure hearts, and Hearer
Lord, dismiss us with Thy blessing
Abide with us, our Savior
Almighty God, Thy Word is cast
For a season called to part
On what has now been sown
Now our worship sweet is o'er
Blest be the tie that binds
Awake, my soul, and with the sun
Now that the sun is beaming bright
While yet the morn is breaking
My inmost heart now raises
Again Thy glorious sun doth rise
All praise to Thee, my God, this night
Abide with me! fast falls the eventide
Sun of my soul, Thou Savior dear
Softly now the light of day
Sunk is the sun's last beam of light
Jesus, tender Shepherd, hear me
Savior, breathe an evening blessing
Hear my prayer, O heavenly Father
Now the day is over
I love to steal awhile away
Father, merciful and holy
Once more a day is at its close
God bless our native land
My country, 'tis of thee
Zion stands with hills surrounded
Glorious things of thee are spoken
The church's one foundation
I love Thy Zion, Lord
note: the number is damaged in the index (1?8); 188 is the one number it lacks, and the body confirms it

first_line: My church! my church, my dear old church
Be not dismayed, thou little flock
Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
Thy scepter, Jesus, shall extend
A mighty Fortress is our God
Abide with us, O Savior dear
Chosen seed and Zion's children
With God and His mercy
note: the index prints "O'son"

first_line: On the mountain's top appearing
Christ, Thou art the sure Foundation
How beauteous are their feet
Savior, sprinkle many nations
Thou, whose almighty word
The morning light is breaking
From Greenland's icy mountains
Now be the gospel banner
Mighty Lord, extend Thy kingdom
O Lord our God, arise
How wondrous and great Thy works, God of praise!
note: the index cuts it short: "How wondrous and great"

first_line: Who is on the Lord's side
O Word of God Incarnate
How precious is the Book divine
Father of mercies, in Thy Word
Lord, keep us steadfast in Thy Word
note: the index cuts it short: "Lord, keep us steadfast"

first_line: How shall the young secure their hearts
What gives the power
Lord of all power and might
The Bible! the Bible
Tell me the old, old story
Blessed Jesus, here we stand
God, in human flesh appearing
Father, who hast created all
Baptized into Thy Name most holy
The death of Jesus Christ, our Lord
Thine own, O loving Savior
Deck thyself, my soul, with gladness
O Living Bread from heaven
Lord Jesus Christ, to Thee we pray
With holy joy my heart doth beat
Crushed by my sin, O Lord, to Thee
Jesus, Thou joy of loving hearts
According to Thy gracious word
Here at Thy table, Lord, we meet
God calling yet! shall I not hear
Awake! the watchman crieth
I hear Thy welcome voice
Come to the Savior, make no delay
Just as thou art, without one trace
Behold a Stranger at the door
Come, ye sinners, poor and needy
Out of the depths I cry to Thee
note: the index cuts it short: "Out of the depths"

first_line: Lord, to Thee I make confession
Lord, we confess our numerous faults
Approach, my soul, the mercy-seat
How helpless guilty nature lies
Show pity, Lord; O Lord, forgive
Lord Jesus Christ, in Thee alone
God of mercy! God of grace
Pass me not, O gentle Savior
Shun, my heart, such thought
Alas! my God, my sins are great
Just as I am, without one plea
In vain we seek for peace with God
My hope is built on nothing less
Not all the blood of beasts
I lay my sins on Jesus
Jesus, Lover of my soul
Rock of Ages, cleft for me
Chief of sinners, though I be
'Tis not by works of righteousness
Jesus, Thy blood and righteousness
Thou art the way; to Thee alone
I was a wandering sheep
One there is above all others
From every stormy wind that blows
All that I was, my sin, my guilt
Pray tell me how cam'st thou
Our God so loved the world
Dear Christians one and all rejoice
Oh, joy of joys! God so did love
I heard the voice of Jesus say
How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord
note: the index cuts it short: "How firm a foundation"

first_line: My faith looks up to Thee
Oh, for a faith that will not shrink
Jesus, I my cross have taken
Am I a soldier of the cross
My soul, be on thy guard
Stand up, stand up for Jesus
So let our lips and lives express
Oh, for a closer walk with God
Oh, for a heart to praise my God
Must Jesus bear the cross alone
Jesus, keep me near the cross
Nearer, my God, to Thee! Nearer to Thee through Word and Sacrament
note: the index gives "Nearer, my God, to Thee" for 282 and 283; 282 is a Lutheran recasting of Sarah Adams's hymn ("Nearer to Thee / Through Word and Sacrament, / Thou com'st to me"), and its first three lines tell it apart; 283 is Adams's

first_line: Nearer, my God to Thee
note: Sarah Adams's; 282 opens alike

first_line: I need Thee, precious Jesus
I need Thee every hour
Guide me, O Thou great Jehovah
Jesus, still lead on
Onward, Christian soldiers
Jesus, King of glory
The little while I linger here
How blest are the hours that Jesus bestows
note: the index cuts it short: "How blest are the hours"

first_line: Rise from thy stupor
Jesus, Thou my heart's Desire
Dear Savior, in Thy bosom hide me
O Lord, devoutly love I Thee
Jesus, keep in memory ever
We Christians should ever consider
I have a Friend so patient, kind, forbearing
note: the index cuts it short: "I have a Friend so patient"

first_line: Jesus, and shall it ever be
Thee will I love, my Strength, my Tower
note: the index cuts it short: "Thee will I love"

first_line: Jesus Lord and precious Savior
Jesus is my Friend most precious
Shine on our souls, eternal God
The Lord my Shepherd is
If God Himself be for me
What our Father does is well
Commit thou all thy griefs
How happy is the man who hears
I am Jesus' little lamb
Though troubles assail us and dangers affright
note: the index cuts it short: "Though troubles assail us"

first_line: God moves in a mysterious way
Let, O my soul, Thy God direct thee
What cheering words are these
Come, ye disconsolate, where'er ye languish
note: the index cuts it short: "Come, ye disconsolate"

first_line: Safe in the arms of Jesus
Wheresoe'er I roam
I would not live alway; I ask not to stay
note: the index cuts it short: "I would not live alway"

first_line: A few more years shall roll
My God, I know that I must die
Lord Jesus Christ, true Man and God
One sweetly solemn thought
I fall asleep in Jesus' wounds
How blest the righteous when he dies
Asleep in Jesus! blessed sleep
Where is the Friend for whom I'm ever yearning
In hope my soul, redeemed to bliss unending
note: the index cuts it short: "In hope my soul redeemed"

first_line: Fade, fade, each earthly joy
We shall sleep but not forever
Day of judgment, day of wonders
The day is surely drawing near
Great God, what do I see and hear
Eternity! most awful word
Abode of peace, my Father's home forever!
note: the index cuts it short: "Abode of peace, my Father's home"

first_line: When I can read my title clear
There is a gate that stands ajar
Joyfully, joyfully, onward we move
note: the index cuts it short: "Joyfully, joyfully"

first_line: Come, O my soul, my every power awaking
I'm a pilgrim, and I'm a stranger
Oh, what has Jesus done for me
When He cometh, when He cometh
I think, when I read that sweet story of old
note: the index cuts it short: "I think when I read that sweet story"

first_line: Around the throne of God in heaven
There is a happy land
In the Christian's home in glory
I love to think of the heavenly land
We speak of the realms of the blest
Shall we meet beyond the river
Shall we gather at the river
There's a land that is fairer than day
There is a land of pure delight
My heart is yearning ever
Jerusalem the golden
Jerusalem, my happy home
Jerusalem, Jerusalem, Thou city ever blest
note: the index cuts it short: "Jerusalem! Jerusalem"; A. O. Bersell's, not F. B. P.'s "Jerusalem, my happy home" (353)

first_line: Jerusalem, thou city fair and high
note: the index cuts it short: "Jerusalem, thou city fair"
